radiusSource: Radius 1.399 (1.371 to 1.427) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 973,019 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.064 (1.024 to 1.104) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5926 +/- 1 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5965406010180880640: teff_gspphot 5925.999 K (16th-84th percentiles 5925.0654-5926.998), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5965406010180880640: teff_gspphot 5925.999 K (16th-84th percentiles 5925.0654-5926.998), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
